To:
Nguyen Hoang Anh
From:
Sofia Martinez
Date:
November 29, 9:41 P.M.
Subject:
Question about group project guidelines
Dear Professor Nguyen,
I wanted to confirm the expectations for our Global Marketing
Strategies group project. The syllabus mentions a
twenty-minute class presentation, but the assignment sheet
you gave us says fifteen minutes. Could you clarify which is
correct?
Also, the assignment calls for case studies from two
countries. Our group is planning to analyze Japan and Brazil,
but we thought there are some interesting points of
comparison with South Korea, Peru, and Ecuador. Would it be
alright if we added one of these as a third country?
Since the presentation is on Dec. 15, we want to ensure we’re
meeting all requirements at this stage.
Thank you for your help!
Best regards,
Sofia Martinez
